author: blu
body: Procedural TrueType font generators. Each generator produces a TtfBuildSpec with glyph outlines as quadratic Bezier contours. Feed the result to ttw-build-ttf to get a valid .ttf byte sequence.

author: blu
body: Three built-in styles: - Block: axis-aligned rectangles, industrial look - Round: rectangles with rounded corners, friendly look - Mono: fixed-width coding font with serifs on I/l, dots on 0
